plants.name: Lavandula angustifolia
plants.description: A fragrant evergreen shrub with slender silvery-green leaves and dense spikes of small tubular flowers. It is widely cultivated for essential oils, culinary use, and as a pollinator-friendly garden plant.
plants.bloomingSeason: Early to late summer (June to August in the Northern Hemisphere)
plants.location: Mediterranean region, cultivated in Provence (France), England, Bulgaria, and the United States
plants.funFact: Lavender's name comes from the Latin 'lavare' meaning 'to wash', as the Romans used it to scent their baths.

plants.name: Echinacea purpurea
plants.description: A hardy perennial wildflower with daisy-like blooms featuring drooping pink-purple petals around a spiky, orange-brown central cone. It thrives in prairies and open woodlands and is a magnet for bees and butterflies.
plants.bloomingSeason: Midsummer to early fall (June to September)
plants.location: Eastern and central North America, prairies and open woods
plants.funFact: The genus name comes from the Greek 'echinos' meaning hedgehog, a reference to the spiny central cone.

plants.name: Nelumbo nucifera
plants.description: An aquatic perennial with large round leaves held above water and spectacular, many-petaled flowers on tall stalks. It grows in shallow ponds, lakes, and slow-moving waters and is revered in many cultures.
plants.bloomingSeason: Summer (June to August), peaking during the monsoon season in Asia
plants.location: South and East Asia, India, China, Vietnam, and northern Australia
plants.funFact: Lotus leaves have a micro-structured surface that repels water and dirt, an effect known as the 'lotus effect' that inspired self-cleaning materials.

plants.name: Protea cynaroides
plants.description: A striking evergreen shrub producing the largest flower head in the Protea genus, with a bowl of silky-tipped bracts surrounding a center of tightly packed florets. It thrives in the nutrient-poor, well-drained soils of fynbos vegetation.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late autumn through spring in the Southern Hemisphere, with blooms often present in midwinter (May to September)
plants.location: Western and Southern Cape, South Africa
plants.funFact: The King Protea is South Africa's national flower and is one of the oldest flowering plant families, dating back around 300 million years.
